## Stage 4

- [ ] Committee approval
- [ ] Implement in two engines/environments
- [ ] Significant in-the-field experience
- [ ] Write test262 tests
- [ ] Merge test262 tests
- [ ] Prepare ecma262 PR
- [ ] Editor-approved ecma262 PR

## Stage 3

- [ ] Committee approval
- [ ] Complete spec text
- [ ] Spec editor signoff
- [ ] Spec reviewer signoff
- [ ] Developer/implementer feedback collected

## Stage 2

- [ ] Committee approval
- [ ] Initial spec text written
- [ ] Reviewers selected

## Stage 1

- [ ] Introduced to TC39
